decision_rationale: This is presented as a whole-epigenome foundation model pretrained on 1.9T tokens and scaled from 90M to 7B, so foundation-model evidence is clear. The record signals generation in the title, but the provided sections do not clearly describe a generative architecture beyond pretraining and alignment embeddings.
evidence_snippet: Title says "Generating and decoding methylated DNA"; abstract says "whole-epigenome foundation models (90M/600M/7B) trained on 1.9T tokens of methylated and unmethylated human DNA."
